args.body:
Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What I liked:
- It's clean and straightforward — the page tells me exactly what it is (your personal website) without any clutter or confusing navigation.
- The contact info is easy to find, which makes it simple to get in touch.

Suggestions for improvement:
- The site is very sparse right now. Adding a short intro about who you are and what you do would help visitors get a sense of you quickly.
- Some sections like "About Me," "Projects/Work," and "Contact" with a bit more detail would make it feel more complete and professional.
- A few links to your other profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub) or recent posts would give people more to explore.

Overall, a nice, no-fuss personal site — it just needs a bit more content to really shine. Would love to see how you develop it!

Best,
Emma Johnson

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What I liked:
- The blog has a clear, personal identity — I immediately learned that it's yours and that hiking is your favorite hobby.
- It's simple and easy to read, with no distracting elements.

Suggestions for improvement:
- Since hiking is your passion, it would be great to see actual blog posts — a few entries about your recent hikes, trail recommendations, gear reviews, or photos would make the site much more engaging.
- Adding a short "About Me" section and an archive or categories of posts would help readers find what interests them.
- Links to your social media or an email contact would make it easier for readers to follow along and get in touch.

Overall, a promising start with a warm personal touch — a bit more content would really bring it to life. Looking forward to reading more!

Best,
Emma Johnson
